title: Flooded-road turn-around rule
summary: Make turning around the default when water covers a road, bridge, underpass, ford, or unknown surface.
content: Practical sequence: Do not walk or drive into moving or depth-unknown water; choose higher ground and a verified alternative route.
steps: Do not walk or drive into moving or depth-unknown water; choose higher ground and a verified alternative route.
short_term: For the first operating cycle of “Flooded-road turn-around rule”, carry out do not walk or drive into moving or depth-unknown water; choose higher ground and a verified alternative route.
